issues.title: [Module 1] Initialize project architecture and Spring Boot backend
issues.body:
### Objective
Establish the foundational Spring Boot Maven project structure and environment configuration for BBSR-explore.

### Description
Initialize the `backend/` directory with Maven, Spring Boot, core dependencies, package layout (`com.bbsrexplore.*`), and externalized environment configuration templates.

### Scope of Work
- [ ] Initialize Maven project (`pom.xml`) and wrapper (`mvnw`, `mvnw.cmd`) under `backend/`
- [ ] Configure core dependencies (Spring Web, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Validation, MySQL Driver)
- [ ] Create base package structure (`config`, `controller`, `dto`, `exception`, `model`, `repository`, `security`, `service`) and `BbsrExploreApplication.java`
- [ ] Add `.env.example` / `application.properties.example` with placeholder keys only (no real secrets)
- [ ] Update `backend/README.md` with verified build and run commands

### Acceptance Criteria
- `./mvnw test` and `./mvnw spring-boot:run` execute cleanly with local configuration
- No credentials or secrets are committed to the repository
- `backend/README.md` documents exact Java/Maven versions and startup steps

### Dependencies
- None

### Technical Notes
Pin a supported Java LTS version and Spring Boot 3.x release. Keep `application-local.properties` and `.env` gitignored.

### Definition of Done
- All required implementation tasks are complete.
- Acceptance criteria are satisfied.
- Relevant tests pass.
- Documentation is updated where required.
- Pull request is reviewed and merged.

### Scope of Work

- Schema supports budget ranges, opening hours, coordinates, accessibility flags, and itinerary ordering

### Dependencies

### Technical Notes
Avoid campus-specific assumptions; ensure `places` supports all 9 Bhubaneswar venue categories.

issues.title: [Module 8] Implement Java-based weighted recommendation engine
issues.body:
### Objective
Implement Stage 2 of the Java recommendation engine: normalized scoring, configurable weights, and ranking.

### Description
Rank eligible venues deterministically using configurable starting weights and missing-data handling.

### Scope of Work
- [ ] Implement normalized sub-scorers (0.0–1.0) for preference match, budget compatibility, distance, ratings, time compatibility, and popularity/context
